title: Fire and Ice: Darkwolf #5
desc:
The Eyes of Mitra await. The sacrificial ritual has begun. Satara and her children stand on the brink of an unthinkable fate as the armies of Vvyndral prepare to witness the birth of a new empire. Only one warrior stands in their way.

Darkwolf has crossed mountains, survived betrayal, and carved a bloody path through the Black Brigade to reach this moment. Now he must face the monstrous Black Claw one final time before confronting the Fire Warlock whose ambition has consumed an entire kingdom.

The spectacular conclusion to the brutal sword-and-sorcery epic inspired by the world of legendary fantasy artist Frank Frazetta's Fire and Ice by writer Dan Panosian and Andrey Lunatik is here!
